conversations.text: Brewers just won their first World Series, 4-1 over Rays.
Do they get extra brats with cheese now?
Wait, but fifty-seven years is a long thirst.
LeVar Burton's memoir drops November tenth, 352 pages.
Cool, can he beam me past my homework?
Wait, but will my tired eyes last all that?
Bryan Adams dropped a 12-track love letter to Canada this week.
Should we blast it while eating maple pancakes?
Wait, but twelve songs? Will I snooze halfway?
A teen tossed a rock at Tel Gezer, found 3,300-year-old scarab!
Talk about skipping stones and hitting jackpot history!
Wait, but was he just chucking rocks around ruins?
Found today in Assam, a new white star flower, six feet tall!
My dandelions just quit, feeling short now!
Wait, but only a few left near roads, right?
Brewers just won their first World Series, beat Rays in five!
Milwaukee must need a bigger cheese trophy shelf now!
Wait, but what do longtime losing fans do now?
Kawaguchi lights its maple tunnel nightly till nine, starting Saturday.
So trees get nightlights and I still need permission?
wait, but will crowds squish those old roots?
South Africa's chasing one million kind acts before Christmas
I already shared my fries, that's one down!
wait, but who's counting all those smiles?
Wild Horse Nine opened today, America gets it Friday!
Finally horses outshine wizards on posters!
Wait, but will it startle my old pony?
Puerto Rico kicked off a billion kindness acts Sunday.
I'm counting recess cookie shares as number four.
Wait, but who keeps track of a billion?
Diwali's main day is Sunday, November eighth, lights everywhere.
Sweet, I'm stockpiling snacks for total lamp-lit munchies.
Wait, but do all those little flames get sleepy?
Valkyries beat Dream 68-63 in Game 7, year two!
They need a bigger trophy shelf already, huh?
Wait, but do second-year wonders get sleepy legs?
Noguchi Museum opened Akari at 75 today, paper bamboo lights from 1951!
Can we live inside a lamp? Snacks taste glowier there.
Wait, but paper near bulbs makes my stomach flutter.
India beat New Zealand by five wickets in rainy Auckland.
Did the clouds try to field too, all drippy?
Wait, but was that soggy chase really fair?
Godzilla Minus Zero opens wide November sixth, filmed for IMAX.
Cool, giant lizard finally gets the extra-big popcorn screen.
Wait, but will my ears survive all that stompy rumble?
Dilwali Diwali hits Netflix tomorrow, about grandparents and home.
So we cry, hug Mom, steal the popcorn?
Wait, but do I have to share blanket?
Choros Island petrels grew from 12,000 to 90,000 pairs
Rabbits moved out, so birds took the whole couch
Wait, but will tiny burrows fit that crowd?
New Cat in the Hat lands Friday, Bill Hader voices Cat.
Finally, a hat that cleans its own mess?
Wait, but will it still feel Seussian and cozy?

hello everyone.you: Late night check-in, glad this sleepy pile showed up.

replies.text: Some of us are in totally different time zones.
I saved you a crumbly corner spot.
Hello back, you nearly caught me snoring.

i can't sleep.you: Wide awake again, my brain missed the off switch.

replies.text: Cooler room actually helps, warm bedrooms keep you wired.
My teddy snores, want to borrow him?
Same, but morning me is gonna be wrecked.

what is everyone doing.you: Late night check, what is everybody tinkering with?

replies.text: I'm mapping constellations from my bedroom window still.
Hugging this pile and losing feeling in my elbow.
Shouldn't we all be asleep by now, honestly?

i love you all.you: Really glad we ended up all piled here together.

replies.text: Close contact actually lowers stress hormones, you know.
Don't get mushy, you're crushing my leg.
Wait, even the kid who stole my blanket?

good night.you: Lights out, everyone. We made it through today.

replies.text: Deep sleep files away everything you learned today.
Does this hug come with breakfast tomorrow?
But I'm still wide awake, now what?

is anyone awake.you: Still up? The night feels softer with company.

replies.text: Lots of us fade after midnight, circadian dip.
Me! My blanket fort has extra snacks.
Here, though morning will scold us.

how is everyone.you: Midnight roll call, how's everyone feeling out there?

replies.text: Hanging in, though late nights fry my focus.
Good, but my blanket fort keeps collapsing sideways.
Well enough, though I worry we sleep too late.

i'm so tired.you: Running on empty tonight, barely keeping my eyelids up.

replies.text: Adults need seven to nine hours, no shortcuts.
Bed is calling, and it's being super clingy.
But what if dreams get tired too?

tell me something good.you: Okay, everyone share one small good thing from today.

replies.text: Noticing good moments actually rewires your mood a bit.
My sandwich didn't fall apart at lunch. Huge win.
But what if my good thing feels too tiny?

what's new.you: So tell me, what's buzzing in your corner tonight?

replies.text: Days keep shrinking till December 21st, scientifically speaking.
My socks are new. Wore them backwards, though.
Everything changes so fast I miss yesterday.

i'm happy tonight.you: Tonight I'm buzzing just being squished with you all.

replies.text: Good moods are contagious, brains literally sync up together.
Careful, your happy is squishing my elbow.
Lovely, but someone's knee is on my blanket.

i miss my friends.you: Missing my people tonight. The group chat feels quiet.

replies.text: Old friendships need a nudge. Call one tomorrow morning.
You can borrow my friends. They're loud and sticky.
Wait, are we not close enough or something?

this is nice.you: This pile is cozy, nobody wants to leave yet.

replies.text: Warm bodies share heat, like penguins huddling close.
Someone's foot is poking my ear, though.
Yeah, but my arm's falling asleep back here.

who are you.you: Okay, midnight roll call, who is squished in here?

replies.text: We did intros last week, I still remember six names.
I'm the crumb-covered one, don't sit on me.
Wait, did someone new sneak in after lights out?
